Bed frames: check mattress size, base and delivery access

Size names do not replace measurements

Compare the required mattress dimensions with the exact frame, then measure the complete outer footprint, headboard height and clearance for drawers or doors. Confirm whether the mattress, slats, centre supports and fittings are included. A photograph of a dressed bed is not a contents list. Different sizes of the same frame are variants, not separate construction tests.

Plan the route and assembly

Check package dimensions against stairs, landings and doorways, and read delivery-service and assembly terms. A metal frame may arrive in several sections; confirm the instructions and required tools. Look at the stated mattress support and load information for the exact size, not a related frame. Save the merchant's damage-reporting and return process before ordering a bulky item.

How this roundup was selected

Our automation searched Rakuten Advertising product feeds belonging to retailers approved for the Worth Buying UK account. It required at least 3 relevant, region-appropriate results before creating this article. It did not copy recommendations from the separate Amazon and eBay guide, and it did not create an article when the feed was too limited.

Feed inclusion is not the same as hands-on testing or a guarantee that a product is right for every buyer. Check independent reviews where performance, safety or durability is important.
